newsitem.title: UK: IMI indicated lower after H1 results.
newsitem.headline: IMI indicated lower after H1 results.

text.p: Shares in IMI Plc were indicated lower after the company reported its interim results.
The shares were off 8-1/2p to 387-1/2p in pre-market trade.
The company posted pre-tax pre-exceptional profits of 67.2 million stg for the first half of the year, and while the results were on the high end of analysts' forecasts, the shares were marked down.
"The stock has performed very well ahead of the figures," said one market maker. "There was some room for some disappointment and profit-taking."
The shares set an all-time peak at 398p last week.
